parameters.label: Commuting threshold
parameters.rationale: Within this road distance the patient travels daily; beyond it they stay near the unit on treatment weeknights and go home at weekends. Framed by the roadmap's 100 km fact.

parameters.label: Planning visits before treatment
parameters.rationale: One round trip for planning (CT simulation) before treatment starts, the same for every schedule.

parameters.label: Breast: long schedule
parameters.rationale: 40 Gy in 15 fractions over 3 weeks, the FAST-Forward control arm and the schedule that stays standard with nodal radiotherapy.

parameters.label: Breast: short schedule
parameters.rationale: 26 Gy in 5 fractions over 1 week, non-inferior in FAST-Forward.

parameters.label: Breast: share treated with radiotherapy
parameters.rationale: No citable Finnish or Nordic population figure was found for the share of new breast cancers that get adjuvant radiotherapy, so this is an assumption.

parameters.label: Breast: share eligible for 5 sessions
parameters.rationale: Eligible = whole breast or chest wall without nodal radiotherapy (RCR). No citable share was found, so the value is an assumption.

parameters.label: Breast: share already on 5 sessions
parameters.rationale: The real current schedule mix in Finland is not public. This dial says how many eligible patients already get 5 sessions; see What units say.

parameters.label: Bone: multi-session course
parameters.rationale: Common multi-fraction comparators include 20 Gy in 5 fractions and 30 Gy in 10 fractions; 5 is the conservative choice.

parameters.label: Bone: single session
parameters.rationale: A single 8 Gy fraction gives pain relief equal to multi-fraction courses.

parameters.label: Bone: retreatment after single session
parameters.rationale: Systematic review of randomised trials: 20% retreated after a single fraction.

parameters.label: Bone: retreatment after multi-session course
parameters.rationale: Same review: 8% retreated after multiple fractions.

parameters.label: Bone: share already single session
parameters.rationale: The current mix is not public. Anchored on Turku University Hospital 2005-2013, where 7% of all radiotherapy courses in the last year of life were single-fraction: single centre, old and not bone-specific.

parameters.label: Kela own-car rate
parameters.rationale: Kela's own-car rate, used to value the trip cost. It is a lower bound on the cost of travel (taxis cost more); what Kela actually reimburses is less, because the patient pays up to 25 € per one-way trip, capped at 300 € a year.

parameters.label: Kela overnight allowance
parameters.rationale: Kela's overnight allowance, at most 20.18 € a night.
